description: Reusable voice-direction presets for prompting, recording and review sessions. Select with `brief --preset <id>` or copy a preset into your session notes. Adjust pacing to the audience and language; always run a listening review before delivery.

presets.name: Calm narration
presets.delivery_notes: Even phrasing, soft consonants, minimal melodic movement; breathe at clause boundaries.
presets.caution: Do not let energy drop so low that intelligibility suffers.

presets.name: Warm conversational
presets.delivery_notes: Sounds like a knowledgeable friend; smile while speaking; allow small hesitations.
presets.caution: Keep filler words deliberate, not careless.

presets.name: Broadcast news
presets.delivery_notes: Neutral accent of the target locale; firm sentence endings; no editorial coloring.
presets.caution: Do not add emotive emphasis; news reads must stay neutral.

presets.name: IVR / telephony friendly
presets.delivery_notes: Slow, deliberate, excellent enunciation for narrowband 8 kHz channels; short sentences; pause before menu options.
presets.caution: Never rush menu prompts; listeners cannot scrub telephony audio.

presets.name: Energetic promo
presets.delivery_notes: High energy with clear consonants; emphasize key verbs; land the call-to-action firmly.
presets.caution: Watch sibilance and peak levels; loud is not the same as clear.

presets.name: Empathetic support
presets.delivery_notes: Acknowledge feelings before information; slight downward inflection; unhurried.
presets.caution: Never perform clinical reassurance you are not authorized to give.

presets.name: Authoritative legal / compliance
presets.delivery_notes: Read disclosures verbatim; no paraphrasing; neutral, dignified tone.
presets.caution: Insertions or omissions in legal copy require explicit legal approval.

presets.name: Clinical clarity
presets.delivery_notes: Pronounce drug and anatomy terms from the verified lexicon; one instruction per sentence.
presets.caution: Non-diagnostic support only; route clinical decisions to licensed professionals.

presets.name: Gentle children's read
presets.delivery_notes: Story-voice with clear character differentiation; pause for illustration beats.
presets.caution: Keep peaks gentle; young listeners are sensitive to harsh sibilance.

presets.name: Tutorial instructor
presets.delivery_notes: Number steps aloud; restate the goal of each section; check in with the learner.
presets.caution: Avoid monotone; comprehension drops when steps blur together.

presets.name: Sports play-by-play
presets.delivery_notes: Ride the action; short bursts; rise on key moments; never sacrifice clarity at peak speed.
presets.caution: Set a ceiling: above ~210 WPM intelligibility collapses for most listeners.

presets.name: Accessibility screen reader
presets.delivery_notes: Consistent rate and pitch; minimal prosodic variation; prioritise crisp consonants over expressiveness.
presets.caution: Do not slow below user preference; power users listen at high rates.
